# Berufsprofil / Professional Summary

Senior Civil Engineer and Hydrogeologist with over 20 years of experience in hydraulic infrastructure, dam design, and large-scale water resource projects. Specialist in computational hydrological and hydraulic modeling, with a strong track record applying Python-driven automation and AI/ML tools to engineering workflows. Holds advanced academic training in hydrogeology and professional language proficiency in German, enabling direct collaboration with German-speaking clients and engineering teams.
